practice_text: An independent, multidisciplinary design practice working across architecture, master planning, interiors, objects and research — combining curiosity, rigorous process and contemporary technology to build spaces that respond to people and place.

Cities across the country with our projects

process_text: An evolving, inclusive process that brings people into the conversation — arriving at thoughtful solutions with the users, for the users.

steps.title: Question
steps.text: Challenge assumptions, interrogate the brief and look beyond the obvious.

steps.title: Decode
steps.text: Read the project through people, place, climate, culture, programme and constraints.

steps.title: Experiment
steps.text: Test ideas through sketches, models, materials and digital tools before settling on answers.

steps.title: Refine
steps.text: Bring space, structure, services, materials, detailing and cost into one coherent system.

steps.title: Realise
steps.text: Carry design through execution with consultants, craftsmen and site teams to protect the original intent.
